notes.title: IJKL movement, more fixes
notes.content:
I've uploaded a new version.

- Adds IJKL movement, as requested by some left-handed users.
- Lets you switch between fullscreen/windowed (although the window is still tiny at the moment).
- Main menu now shows all the buttons/commands (such as +/- for adjusting volume) which were previously undocumented.
- Fixes the remaining scenarios where you could jump out of Granita Island.

Working on at least having some basic controller support.

notes.title: More updates, plus a blog post
notes.content:
I've put out another update. This one fixes two issues:

- Losing hearts or the double-jump boots when the game crashes or is closed via Alt+F4.
- Jumping so far off the screen that you don't come down anymore.

If you're interested in game design, you might be interested in a blog post I wrote about the influence of old freeware & shareware games on my work, with Omegaland as a main example.

notes.title: First Updates
notes.content:
I've made a couple of updates to the game so far:

- Fixed a potential scenario where the game fails to reload when you die.
- Fixed an empty sign.
- You can no longer collect jump upgrades, then jump offscreen in Granita Island.
- Removed a couple of old lines of code that could theoretically cause trouble.
- Fixed two achievements ("Bears! Bears!" and "Engorge")
- Added a version of the game (available via Properties/Betas) that doesn't require admin rights.
- Fixed a monster in Dessert Bluffs that was walking in the air a bit.
- Adjusted music volume, added the (as yet undocumented) option on adjust music volume with +/-.

Many thanks to Steam community member Wok, who tracked down and reported some obscure cases.
